verdict.rationale: Supermemory is an API product, so a versioned API with a documented deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version numbers, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The API reference only notes that official TypeScript and Python clients wrap the API, which says nothing about versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
